title: Spell objects rebuilt in 3D
changes: Crimson Tide's blood spikes, earth and ice spikes and trap spikes are now 3D models that burst out of the ground, in three shapes so a field of them never repeats.
The Summoner's orbiting void blades are 3D, drawn from 16 angles as they circle.
Native Soil spills a 3D patch of grave earth with clods and bone chips.
The falling Judgement sword, Avalanche boulders and rain arrows are 3D models too.
